envelope.description: Carry uxDefinition onto the docs-content message and resolve its anchor host-side

body.title: Carry uxDefinition onto the docs-content message and resolve its anchor host-side
body.summary: Close the one-hop gap. Add two optional fields to the docs-content variant of HostToWebview — `uxDefinition` typed by INDEXING off DocsContent, and `experienceAnchorSlug` — and forward them in openDoc by conditional spread, resolving the ux-mock ref's ofSectionId HOST-side with sc3's shipped createSectionResolver exactly as s3 resolves the diagram's. The record already reaches the host (docs-review-client.ts:37, forwarded :113) and is dropped before posting; this is purely that one hop. No daemon file is touched: uxDefinition is one of sc1's ORIGINAL four projected fields.
acceptanceChecks: openDoc forwards uxDefinition BY REFERENCE on the existing docs-content message — no new message type, no new IPC method, no second round trip
An absent record stays an ABSENT KEY, asserted with `'uxDefinition' in payload === false` rather than a loose falsy check

The ux-mock ref's ofSectionId is resolved with sc3's createSectionResolver over the index derived from THIS markdown, and an unresolvable id posts NO experienceAnchorSlug key rather than an empty string
Both protocol fields use the INDEXED form (`DocsContent['uxDefinition']`), matching the five siblings, so protocol -> client -> daemon stay one declaration deep
openDoc's FAIL-CLOSED arm posts blocked:true and carries NO uxDefinition — a reviewer who could not read the body is never shown a mock drawn from it
The emitted shell is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the current pinned baseline: this task moves data, not pixels, and nothing has joined the script yet
NO file under src/ is modified — provable by diffing the task's changed set, and the fact that distinguishes this Story from S003

tests.name: openDoc posts uxDefinition by reference on the existing docs-content message (identity-compared, not deep-equalled)
openDoc omits the uxDefinition KEY entirely when the record is absent ('uxDefinition' in payload === false)
openDoc resolves a ux-mock ref's ofSectionId to experienceAnchorSlug via createSectionResolver over this markdown's index
openDoc posts NO experienceAnchorSlug key for an unresolvable ofSectionId (not an empty string)
openDoc's fail-closed arm posts blocked:true and carries no uxDefinition
the emitted shell is byte-identical to the pinned baseline after t1 (data moved, no pixels)
t1's changed-file set contains nothing under src/
